name: D3DAppFilterFlags
meaning: Third argument of D3DApp_Construct 0x40464F, controlling which enumerated devices and modes are copied into the D3DApp object. WinMain passes 3.

name: D3DAPP_FILTER_NO_WINDOWED
meaning: Copy only modes whose dwWidth != 0, i.e. drop the "Windowed Mode" pseudo-entry from every device's list. bDesktopCompatible is still copied, which is what makes Render_Present's modeIndex==0 test wrong.

name: D3DAPP_FILTER_NO_RGB
meaning: Skip any enumerated device whose description begins with "RGB" (the RGB Emulation software rasterizer).
